title: Susceptibility of qudit-qudit entanglement to quantum noise: insights from the negativity rank
summary: One aspect of complexity for quantum many-body systems resides in their ability to exhibit entanglement, uniquely quantum correlations central to quantum computation. To quantitatively explore the diminishing effect that quantum noise has on entanglement resources, we focus on the negativity witness, an entanglement measure based on local time reversal transformations that provides a perfect witness in simple physical contexts.
